title.narrative: Scaling-Up Resilient, Green, and Affordable Housing in the Eastern Caribbean

description.narrative: Active

GGGI will support Caribbean SIDS public and private finance sector actors to develop adequate sustainable finance capacity, strategic frameworks, and instruments leading to the mobilization of USD 100+M for low carbon resilient projects that contribute to enhanced resilience of 6M people and creation of green jobs. The project will work to achieve this impact by delivering a range of workstream including: i )Leveraging the Blue Economy through Sustainable Finance; ii) Building Resilience Through the Banking Sector; iii) Driving Private Sector Investments in Climate Change through Climate-Smart Public Private Partnership; iv) Climate Resilience as Credit Enhancement; and v) SIDS Knowledge Sharing
